entries.value: Mossback Deer — a calm forest grazer whose antlers host flowers, insects, and medicinal herbs.
Lantern Finch — a tiny bird with glowing feathers that gathers near safe campsites.
River Otter — a playful, clever swimmer that trades polished stones for food.
Cloud Sheep — a woolly mountain animal light enough to survive long falls.
Copper Fox — a curious red fox attracted to coins, keys, and quiet music.
Burrow Pig — a sturdy forager able to locate roots, truffles, and shallow buried objects.
Long-Eared Hare — an alert grassland animal that stamps before storms or approaching danger.
Bluehorn Goat — a sure-footed cliff grazer with mineral-rich blue horns.
Reed Crane — a patient marsh bird often following travelers through safe water.
Honey Bear — a small gentle bear with golden fur and an excellent memory for kindness.
Sailback Turtle — a broad river turtle whose shell catches wind while swimming.
Ember Newt — a warm-bodied amphibian commonly found sleeping beside ovens.
Silk Alpaca — a mild-tempered herd animal producing unusually strong, soft fiber.
Rain Frog — a bright frog whose call reliably predicts rainfall several hours ahead.
Moon Moth — a hand-sized silver moth that feeds on magical residue without harming spells.
Pebble Crab — a harmless shore crab that decorates its shell with colorful stones.
Whistle Marmot — a social alpine rodent with distinct warning calls for different threats.
Orchard Drake — a flightless lizard that eats pests and warms fruit trees during frost.
Mist Dolphin — a pale coastal dolphin that guides lost vessels away from reefs.
Star Elk — a rare nocturnal deer whose coat resembles the current night sky.
Memory Crow — a friendly black bird able to repeat one sentence it heard years ago.
Glimmer Whale — a gentle deep-sea giant whose songs make plankton shine.
